Getting started

Version 4 · Last updated 14 October 2026

Livo asks for nothing at first launch. Getting Started is a list of six optional steps you can take in any order, now or later.

Open it from the line under the Gallery’s header, from Organize › Getting Started, or from Settings › About. Each row shows a tick when it is done, and you can swipe a row left to skip it for now.

1. Your name

Stamps your Time Capsules and signs your stories. Typing your name also creates you as a Person, so you can tag yourself in photos. Change it any time in Settings › Your Name.

2. Your look

Livo is always dark, with white lettering, in one of three palettes: Charcoal (the default), Slate, or Spring, the lightest. Change it any time in Settings › Appearance.

3. Your photos

Bring in your Camera Roll, or scan prints. Livo keeps a small copy of each photo; your photos stay where they are, and Livo never deletes or changes them. Livo asks for permission to your photos when you start the import, and for the camera when you scan prints. See Bringing in your photos.

4. Keep a copy

Optional. Until you choose a place, your Time Capsules are only on this phone. Choose a folder in Files (iCloud Drive, Dropbox or another app), or OneDrive, and every sealed capsule is copied there too, and checked. Add places in Vault › Places. Backups are separate: Organize › Backup & Restore.

5. Share with family

Optional. Send Time Capsules any way you like. With a free Microsoft account (a personal account is enough; nothing to buy), you can also see what your family shares in their OneDrive and share back. Everything each person shares stays in their own OneDrive; nothing goes through a server. Livo works fully without a Microsoft account. See Family Share.

6. Where things are

A short tour of the places in Livo: the Gallery, Memory Lane, the Vault and the book. See Where things are.
